// diagnostic

E0443

An `if` table's hole is written `<>`, not `_`

What

An `if` table's hole is written `<>`, not `_`

Why

`_` is a value thrown away, so it can't stand for the candidate each arm puts in the header

Fix

Write `<>` in place of `_`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0443: Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_underscore.stderr.

Error [jet.UnderscoreHole]: An `if` table's hole is written `<>`, not `_`
  --> Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_underscore.jet:4:12
    |
  4 |     if n % _ == 0 {
    |            ^
 Why: `_` is a value thrown away, so it can't stand for the candidate each arm puts in the header
 Fix: Write `<>` in place of `_`
